svg.title: Cardiac cell
svg.desc: Branched cardiomyocyte with central nucleus, sarcomeric striations, mitochondria, and dark intercalated discs. Biological basis: Cardiomyocytes are branched striated cells joined end-to-end by intercalated discs containing mechanical and electrical junctions.
